messages:
sara: customer hitting 422 schema validation on tool call ledger:update_txn. Error says transactionAmount expected number but got string. RequestID: req_1719876543. Also customer mentioned intermittent 401s and a billing spike. Can we gather curl, logs, and a debug bundle?

mike: can you paste the exact curl you used?

sara: sure — here is what they ran (api key redacted):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tool/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_redacted" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_1719876543" \
  -d '{"tool":"ledger:update_txn","input":{"transactionId":"txn_9","transactionAmount":"100.00","currency":"USD"}}'
```
Response they got:
```json
{"error":{"code":422,"message":"schema validation failed","details":[{"path":"input.transactionAmount","error":"expected number"}]},"request_id":"req_1719876543"}
```

jen: hmm the payload clearly has transactionAmount as a string. Customer says earlier versions accepted strings. @eng-ml-bot did we change validation?

eng-ml-bot: we deployed stricter tool-call JSON schema validation in commit 9f3a2c on 2026-02-28. ledger:update_txn now requires transactionAmount:number. Previously it accepted string|number. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/commits/9f3a2c

alice: we should collect a debug bundle: gateway/proxy logs, tools runtime stdout/stderr for node that served req_1719876543 (tools-12), and the customer's request/response from the gateway. Also ask customer to capture SDK logs and a curl repro with X-Request-ID. I'll prepare a bundle template.

sara: gateway log snippet for req_1719876543: 
```
[2026-03-01T14:12:03Z] req=req_1719876543 method=POST path=/v1/tool/invoke status=422 backend=tools-12 node=tools-12.local latency=122ms
body={"tool":"ledger:update_txn","input":{"transactionId":"txn_9","transactionAmount":"100.00","currency":"USD"}}
```

mike: can you try reproducing locally with numeric transactionAmount to confirm server accepts numbers?

sara: numeric value returns 200 OK locally: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tool/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_redacted" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"ledger:update_txn","input":{"transactionId":"txn_9","transactionAmount":100.00,"currency":"USD"}}'
```
So server accepts numbers. Looks like client SDK is serializing this field as string.

jen: aside from the type issue, customer saw intermittent 401s and a billing metric spike — could be retry storms from their SDK. @support-bot can you correlate counts for that customer and breakdown 422 vs 200 vs 401 around req_1719876543?

support-bot: running query... attaching results.

support-bot: results: in 10m window around req_1719876543 -> 422:124, 200:18, 401:7. Top user-agent: "vendor-sdk/2.3.1". Note: several 401s where X-Request-ID header is missing.

alice: next steps proposed:
1) Ask customer to upgrade SDK to latest (2.3.4) which fixes numeric marshaling bug.
2) Provide a curl sample with a numeric transactionAmount and request they include X-Request-ID for failing calls.
3) Produce a debug bundle (gateway logs, tools-12 logs, pod metadata, request traces) and attach to ticket.
4) Engineering (mike) will open a 72-hour lenient coercion feature-flag to accept string->number for ledger:update_txn and monitor.

mike: I'll put up a canary flag to coerce number strings for ledger:update_txn for 72h and route 10% of traffic. If metrics look stable we can extend.

sara: I'll update the customer with repro steps, the curl sample, and ask for any additional failing request IDs and SDK logs. Also ask them to run curl with --trace-ascii to capture TLS/HTTP details.

alice: creating debug bundle: debug-bundles/db-1719876543.tar.gz (internal link). tagging eng-runtime and billing.

sara: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll attach the bundle and the canary flag info to the support ticket and follow up with the customer.

mike: follow-up: if they confirm SDK upgrade works we can close. If not, we need to check whether any gateway param mangling occurs for certain user-agents.

jen: note for incident timeline: deploy 9f3a2c (schema tightening) -> increased 422s starting ~2026-03-01T14:10Z -> billing spike correlated with retry loops from vendor-sdk/2.3.1.

sara: acknowledged, assigning to eng-runtime for monitoring and support for customer remediation.

(attachments: gateway_log_snippet.txt, debug-bundles/db-1719876543.tar.gz, support_query_results_1719876543.csv)
